components.name: Editorial Action Link
components.description: Gold text action for paths from homepage sections into full views.
components.css: .ds-action-link { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; color:var(--gold, #c7a66a); font:800 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-color:transparent; text-underline-offset:5px; transition:text-decoration-color .18s ease; } .ds-action-link:hover { text-decoration-color:currentColor; } .ds-action-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #c7a66a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Featured Match
components.description: Dominant homepage choice with league, teams, kickoff or score, and verified state.
components.css: .ds-featured-match { display:block; width:100%; min-height:358px; padding:22px 24px 28px; border:1px solid var(--line, rgba(205,220,214,.12)); border-radius:16px; background:#11161b; color:var(--text, #edf2ed); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-featured-top { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; padding-bottom:20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(205,220,214,.12)); } .ds-featured-top b { padding:8px 11px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--gold, #c7a66a); color:#101317; font:700 11px/1.2 'Space Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-featured-top span { overflow:hidden; color:#b8c1bd; font:700 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-featured-body { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(110px,.55fr) minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:24px; min-height:280px; padding-top:20px; } .ds-featured-team, .ds-featured-score { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:10px; min-width:0; text-align:center; } .ds-featured-team > i { display:grid; width:88px; height:88px; place-items:center; color:var(--muted, #8e9a98); font:normal 36px/1 sans-serif; } .ds-featured-team strong { overflow-wrap:anywhere; font:700 clamp(18px,2.2vw,27px)/1.05 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-featured-team small, .ds-featured-score i { color:#aab4b0; font:normal 11px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-featured-score strong { font:700 clamp(29px,4vw,45px)/1 'Space Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-.035em; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-featured-match:hover { background:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035), rgba(255,255,255,.035)), #11161b; } .ds-featured-match:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #c7a66a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Next Match
components.description: Compact supporting row in the three-match next queue.
components.css: .ds-next-match { display:grid; grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr); gap:5px 10px; width:100%; min-height:91px; padding:13px 2px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(205,220,214,.12)); background:transparent; color:var(--text, #edf2ed); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-next-time { grid-row:1 / span 2; padding-top:3px; color:var(--gold, #c7a66a); font:700 13px/1.2 'Space Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-next-teams { display:grid; gap:6px; min-width:0; font:700 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-next-match small { grid-column:2; overflow:hidden; color:#8f9a96; font:400 11px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-next-match:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); } .ds-next-match:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #c7a66a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Honest Live Strip
components.description: Verified live summary or explicit no-live empty state.
components.html:
LIVE
Сейчас матчей нетЗдесь появятся счёт и статус после стартового свистка.
components.css: .ds-live-strip { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:24px; min-height:64px; padding:10px 18px; border:1px solid rgba(134,200,164,.28); border-radius:12px; background:#101b18; color:var(--text, #edf2ed); font-family:'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-live-label { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; color:var(--green, #86c8a4); font:700 12px/1.2 'Space Mono', monospace; } .ds-live-label i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45); } .ds-live-strip div { display:grid; gap:3px; } .ds-live-strip strong { font-size:12px; } .ds-live-strip small { color:#91a69d; font-size:11px; } .ds-live-strip:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #c7a66a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Schedule Row
components.description: Dense league-grouped match row with stable time, teams, and score columns.
components.css: .ds-schedule-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr) 58px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:7px 10px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(205,220,214,.12)); background:transparent; color:var(--text, #edf2ed); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-schedule-row time, .ds-schedule-row strong { color:#b6c0bc; font:400 11px/1.2 'Space Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-schedule-row span { overflow:hidden; font:700 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-schedule-row strong { text-align:center; } .ds-schedule-row:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); } .ds-schedule-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #c7a66a); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Match Search Field
components.description: Incumbent match-centre search field preserved alongside the homepage extension.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="m16 16 5 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Команда или лига" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; display:block; color:var(--muted, #8e9a98); } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; top:50%; left:16px; width:20px; height:20px; transform:translateY(-50%); pointer-events:none; } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px 0 44px; border:1px solid var(--line, rgba(205,220,214,.12)); border-radius:16px; outline:none; background:var(--surface, #12171c); color:var(--text, #edf2ed); font:400 14px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--muted, #8e9a98); } .ds-search input:focus { border-color:rgba(101,119,255,.45); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(101,119,255,.08); }

components.name: Selected Match Filter
components.description: Selected state for the existing match-centre filter family.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { min-height:44px; padding:0 17px; border:1px solid rgba(101,119,255,.38); border-radius:13px; background:rgba(101,119,255,.15); color:var(--text, #edf2ed); cursor:pointer; font:700 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { background:rgba(101,119,255,.2); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--blue, #93b8aa); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Link
components.description: Muted header route that brightens and gains a gold rule when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position:relative; display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; color:#a7b1ad; font:700 12px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.ds-is-active { color:var(--text, #edf2ed); } .ds-nav-link.ds-is-active::after { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:0; left:0; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--gold, #c7a66a); content:''; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--gold, #c7a66a); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
AlmazStat is an established dark football-data system. Its homepage extends that incumbent identity with the hierarchy of a restrained sports broadcast: one decisive headline match, a compact queue of what follows, a truthful live signal, and a complete schedule beneath. The interface should feel informed and immediate, not theatrical or promotional.

This is an evolution of the existing product world rather than a new global visual identity. Dark tonal surfaces, compact data density, Russian-first labels, team marks, and numeric clarity remain foundational; the editorial hierarchy is strongest on the homepage and should not force every utility or detail screen into the same composition.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, low-glare football surfaces with fine cool hairlines.
Muted gold for editorial priority and navigation emphasis.
Green reserved for verified live state and score information.
Oversized editorial introduction paired with compact tabular match data.
Calm, factual empty, loading, and error states with no invented content.

rules.name: The Verified Green Rule
rules.body: Use live green only when the current match status is in the product's live-status set; an empty live strip remains factual and does not simulate activity.

rules.name: The Warm Priority Rule
rules.body: Gold expresses editorial importance or an active path. It is not a decorative wash and should not tint large surfaces.

rules.name: The Numeric Instrument Rule
rules.body: Render scores, kickoff times, and live labels in Space Mono with tabular numerals; prose and team names remain in DM Sans.

rules.name: The Rank Before Scale Rule
rules.body: Use the largest type for the day and the featured score, then step sharply down into compact match metadata.

rules.name: The 800px Recomposition Rule
rules.body: Do not merely shrink the desktop grid; below 800px, stack the stage and explicitly recompose dense schedule rows.

rules.name: The Incumbent Measure Rule
rules.body: The 1180px width belongs to the desktop shell and homepage canvas; existing focused screens keep their 760px content measure.

rules.name: The Flat Broadcast Rule
rules.body: Homepage information panels stay flat; hierarchy comes from composition, tonal surface changes, and typography rather than floating card shadows.

rules.name: The Quiet Corner Rule
rules.body: Reserve large legacy radii for existing detail cards; the homepage's editorial panels use the tighter 16px silhouette.

dos: Do preserve the incumbent dark palette, DM Sans/Space Mono pairing, team marks, and compact data density when extending the product.
Do keep the homepage order as featured choice, next queue, truthful live strip, and full league-grouped schedule.
Do use actual API-backed teams, competitions, times, statuses, and scores; provide calm empty or error copy when data is absent.
Do recompose at 800px and keep interactive targets at least 44px high.
Do make focus visible with the established gold homepage or sage incumbent outline.
donts: Don't promote the homepage composition into a mandatory template for match details, search, leagues, teams, or analytics.
Don't use live green for upcoming, selected, loading, or decorative states.
Don't invent editorial headlines, promotional claims, photos, metrics, or live activity that the source data does not provide.
Don't flatten the day into a wall of equal cards; editorial rank and full schedule serve different scanning needs.
Don't add floating shadows or saturated color washes to redesigned homepage panels; preserve the quiet tonal depth.
